runtime_rule: Rust owns project runtime. No Python tinygrad interpreter or Python worker is a completed native backend. Build-time source extraction/oracles are separate.

source_responsibilities.hardware: openpilot/system/hardware/usbgpu.py: ordered discovery, firmware/speed/link diagnostics, signed INA231 status, two fresh checks and PCIe-only retry
source_responsibilities.selection: openpilot/selfdrive/modeld/helpers.py: device/layout selection, chunked compiled artifact, current/previous model, discovery grace, nested transient causes
source_responsibilities.provisioning: openpilot/selfdrive/modeld/big_model.py and precompiled_model.py: pinned manifest, resume/hash/size, atomic current/previous state, runtime provenance, archive constraints and failure rejection
source_responsibilities.compilation: openpilot/selfdrive/modeld/compile_modeld.py and pinned generic compile_onnx/compile_warp: supported model compile/update, preserved kernel/model identity and recurrent graph
source_responsibilities.execution: precompiled_runner.py, precompiled_worker.py, generic_model_runtime.py: inputs/layout, output aliases, first/steady deadlines, parent cleanup and recurrent feedback
source_responsibilities.preupload: local_gpu_warp.py: C3-only QCOM path, actual AMD/QCOM probe comparison, exact sampling-boundary rule and AMD fallback
source_responsibilities.integration: modeld.py: five-second remembered-device discovery, six initialization attempts, 120-second load policy, live Params/diagnostics/tmux queue, warm internal model and same-frame fallback
source_responsibilities.usb_amd: original and artifact-pinned tinygrad USB/PCIe/AMD initialization, memory, ELF kernels, command queues, synchronization, firmware and teardown

exact: USB control/bulk and PCIe packets, byte ordering, retry conditions and partial-transfer handling
register masks/addresses, page tables, kernel arguments/ELF bytes, dispatch ordering and synchronization
artifact hashes, chunk boundaries, selected model/checkpoint, tensor dimensions/layout/dtype, aliasing and recurrence
model input/output transport bytes, finite-validity decisions, fallback and failure classification
source diagnostics and UI JSON success-versus-boundary-failure distinction
C3 validation decision for every pixel; no percentage/intensity tolerance

numerical.unchanged_compiled_kernels: retain original kernel binaries and constants; byte-identical commands/arguments and buffer input/output traces on owned host driver fixtures; physical AMD results remain a later device gate

owned_f32_preprocessing.discrete_decisions: exact; any differing safety/selection/validity branch fails

numerical.raw_predictions_and_recurrence: no newly introduced approximation; reuse established parser/publication contracts, preserve original dtype and in-place feedback aliases

ui_boundary.exit_zero: completed diagnostic including normal GPU check failure
ui_boundary.exit_nonzero: invalid arguments or inability to spawn/communicate with native probe

validation: actual original source comparison, not copied expected output
native binaries with private sysfs/USB/driver/process/IPC fixtures
artifact identity and complete responsibility ledger
owned memory/lifetime/synchronization checks and appropriate Miri/native sanitizers
portable host and parent ARM/CI integration gates
prohibited_validation: No vehicle/C3X, physical GPU, NAS, account or production service access; no device-test handoff; no CPU-savings claim. Never count a status-only probe or hidden Python child as completion.
